note:
Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the wallace_2026_s2c_selfcert cache into this table's own cache dir; sha256 77e72d25dd6fc1f8800272508884584543e1b81e4b452795fbf26e8c40e4732e verified; the S2c .sps contains no uncertmind line). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2c_uncertmind.csv = (s2c, [(uncertmind{i} -> uncertmind{i}, rev 0) for i in 1,2,3]): the IRW code IS the source column name (.sav columns 0-based 59-61). No '-' flip prefix, so resp is the deposited value and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column (confirmed: live columns id,item,resp,treat,cov_*). Exempt from Step 5b (code is the source column name), no verification files. TEXT: variable labels shipped verbatim except that Qualtrics line-break artifacts ('that
you' in uncertmind1, 'is
unlikely' in uncertmind2, 'issue,
there' in uncertmind3) were replaced by single spaces; curly apostrophes (U+2019) kept as in the file; uncertmind3's comma splice kept uncorrected. No lead-in in any label, instructions left blank. OPTIONS: all seven points value-labelled on all three items: 1 Strongly agree, 2 Agree, 3 Somewhat agree, 4 Neither agree nor disagree, 5 Somewhat disagree, 6 Disagree, 7 Strongly disagree; shipped verbatim (no number prefixes present, nothing padded), including uncertmind3's point 1 capitalised 'Strongly Agree' as in the file. DIRECTION: 1 = Strongly agree, so a higher resp means LESS agreement that certainty/uncertainty is fixed (i.e. a more malleable uncertainty mindset), matching the processing-script docstring (_s2c_uncertmind among the tables running 1 = Strongly agree ... 7 = Strongly disagree). INSTRUMENT: the deposit names no scale; the instrument field is an IRW-descriptive label read off the item content, matching the dictionary Description 'Uncertainty mindset'. COUNTS: source 793 rows, 793 non-missing per item; live 2379 rows = 793 ids x 3; per-item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: uncertmind1 20/35/84/102/177/234/141, uncertmind2 16/35/93/117/160/246/126, uncertmind3 14/32/90/110/136/256/155. RIGHTS: study's own items, no published instrument identified, so no originator page and no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies; nothing located reserves a right, silence is permission; no register row written. Wording copied from the study's own .sav labels.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement that one's certainty or uncertainty is fixed.
